research_rule: Математика не сходится. Пока не сойдется.
hypothesis: When a wide boundary has compact exact semantics but global ROBDD compilation is expensive, JANUS can discover a factorized boundary representation from the CNF's internal interaction graph and compile exact local cut messages with total work scaling with local component width rather than global 2^k boundary size.
solver_input: Obfuscated CNF plus supplied boundary variables only. No generator blocks, family labels, expected messages or hidden relation labels.
local_factor_algorithm: Remove supplied boundary variables from the internal connectivity graph only for component discovery.
Find connected components of internal variables from actual clause incidence.
Assign each clause to the unique internal component it touches; reject factor-DAG fast path if a clause touches multiple discovered internal components.
For each component, determine its incident boundary scope from clauses.
Exactly existentially project the component by exhaustive LOCAL assignments over that component's internal variables and its incident boundary scope.
Store the canonical local truth relation as a content-addressed factor node.
The global boundary message is the conjunction DAG of those exact local factors; do not flatten to a global truth table or ROBDD.

resource_integrity.local_assignments_enumerated: allowed only inside discovered local components and fully charged
resource_integrity.truthgate_replay: rebuild factors independently from CNF and compare canonical hashes
resource_integrity.ROBDD_baseline: same input CNF/boundary; full min-fill/build/quantification/replay accounting

gates.F1_EXACTNESS_AND_REPLAY: 100% factor-DAG messages must replay and match independent evaluation audit.
gates.F2_NO_GENERATOR_ORACLE: No hidden block/family metadata enters solver.
gates.F3_ZERO_GLOBAL_BOUNDARY_ENUMERATION: No 2^k global boundary assignment enumeration in factor-DAG construction.
gates.F4_LOCAL_WIDTH_DISCOVERED: Every successful factor-DAG case must report discovered local scope/component widths and charge local enumeration; no hardcoded block IDs.
gates.F5_COMPACT_MESSAGE: For k>=15 median factor-DAG serialized bytes / 2^k <= 0.10 and node count grows at most linearly on the frozen ladder.
gates.F6_COMPILATION_ESCAPE: For k>=15 median paid Factor-DAG work / paid ROBDD work <= 0.25.
gates.F7_FACTOR_DAG_SCALING: Adjacent median paid Factor-DAG work growth <=2.0 across the frozen +3-bit ladder.
gates.F8_ROBDD_CONTROL: ROBDD baseline must be recorded on every case whether it wins or loses; absence of ROBDD blowup does not invalidate Factor-DAG exactness but weakens the representation-switch claim.
gates.F9_TRUTHGATE_PROOFPACK: Authority requires canonical factor hashes plus independent replay; scheduler/ranking is advisory only.
gates.F10_UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_BOUNDARY_ELIMIN: OPEN unless arbitrary-CNF formal polynomial bounds are proved.
